description: Crown Contaminated Sites is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by GeoBC – Geospatial Services. This data set represents general site location points where the Crown Contaminated Sites Program (CCSP) has conducted work from 2022 to 2024. The work is outlined in the 2024 Biennial Report which documents progress over the past two years. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher GeoBC – Geospatial Services. Its tags are Biennial Report, Crown Contaminated Sites, Crown contaminate site, contaminated, contaminated sites. It offers 1 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2025-07-14 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Access Only. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
